analysis_units: Repeated conditions on the same targets; five official test folds are retained. Mixture rows are not independent training/test splits.
intentional_missing_fields: Distractor label, distractor score, capture flag and margin are undefined for white/DEMAND rows (50% of own rows). They are not imputed or interpreted as missing predictions.
type_corrections: File names, row IDs, fold IDs, class IDs and condition names are nominal identifiers; automatic numeric-ID correlations are not interpreted.
chart_choice: Use ordered-level curves for performance and capture; within-model boxplots for margins and representation shifts; paired fold points for overlap strata; exploratory capture counts; log-scale CPU latency. No significance claims are inferred from descriptive fold SD.
alternative_views: The exported fold/trial CSVs support paired effect plots and distribution plots; a single ranked bar chart would hide protocol, dose and overlap differences.
